scope: SD-based I_id and SEM over 828 directed tRNA mutations; production numeric kernel replayed with the author notebook per-count seeds, checked against independent sequence-substitution enumeration. The public global estimator uses a different RNG stream and is tested separately against a same-stream oracle.
preprocessing: Retain all 28,530 genotypes with Fit > 0.5, including 3,903 isolates; preserve source row order; use ln(Fit/0.5). Match positions 1..69 and every ordered A/C/G/T allele pair. Draw n random pairs with replacement using RandomState(n**2+3), ddof=0; mean and population SD/sqrt(828).

sources.locator: Results, Epistasis is highly idiosyncratic, p. 1686 (PDF page 2): I_id=0.612 +/- 0.005 s.e.m.; Methods, Estimating the idiosyncrasy index, p. 1692 (PDF page 8).
Code cell 3: directed mutations, matched n controls and n**2+3 seed.

comparison.justification: Half of the last printed decimal unit for both mean and SEM. This is rounding tolerance, not an acceptance interval for arbitrary random seeds.
